artists.source_line: LTP presents: BACHAKIZ NOTTINGHAM FESTIVAL 8TH EDITION

features.quote: Anything and everything will take place under one roof at BachaKiz:
features.rationale: The text says the festival events take place under one roof, at the Mercure hotel venue where dancers are invited to stay.

features.quote: The 2 party rooms at the moment (more to be announced) will be as follows:
features.rationale: Two separate party rooms are stated, meaning more than one dance room.
The text refers to workshops that attendees of the full pass take part in, so classes are part of the event.
